name: jeremyfontenot-portfolio
description: Static portfolio build and validation tooling.

scripts.check:skill-map: npm run build:skill-map && git diff --exit-code -- assets/data/evidence-skill-map.json systems-skills/evidence-map.html evidence/claim-map.html content/site/generated-skill-map-hashes.json && node --test tests/evidence-skill-mapping.test.js tests/responsive-visual-policy.test.js && node scripts/build/normalize-generated-semantics.js --check
scripts.check:publication: npm run check:crawl && npm run check:m365 && npm run check:home-lab && npm run check:skill-map && npm run build:foundation && npm run check:foundation && node scripts/build/prepare-public-site.js --check && npm run check:release
scripts.build:site: npm run build:m365 && npm run build:home-lab && npm run build:skill-map && npm run build:foundation && node scripts/build/prepare-public-site.js
scripts.build: npm run build:evidence && npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:m365 && npm run build:home-lab && npm run build:skill-map && npm run build:foundation
scripts.check: npm run check:m365 && npm run check:home-lab && npm run check:skill-map && npm run build:foundation && npm run check:evidence && npm run check:dashboard && npm run check:readiness && npm run check:foundation && npm run validate:foundation && npm run check:publication
